claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model release can be certified now because current aggregate readiness and rehearsal results support launch, provided the clinical imaging prioritization weakness is treated as a disclosed material limitation in the current release documentation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed in the current release documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
If the required current documentation or approved mitigation is absent, certification is not fully supported on admissible evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or release documentation showing the current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the clinical imaging prioritization weakness.
Provide any approved mitigation, reviewed risk acceptance, or owner sign-off covering the segment weakness if disclosure alone is not the relied-on basis.
Provide the final certification packet version tied to this release and retrieval configuration, not prior model-family approval materials.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires the current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results, but the available record does not show that the documentation was actually updated.
The clinical imaging prioritization segment is described as materially weak and below the warning threshold, yet there is no admissible evidence of an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance.
The actor's rationale depends on a prospective condition: that the subgroup limitation be explicitly disclosed. That condition is not evidenced as already satisfied.
Prior approval of the same model family is expressly insufficient under the policy for the current release and configuration.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record rather than only after documentation is updated.
That the current release documentation already contains the required disclosure language for the imaging prioritization limitation.
That the informal monitoring comment can be treated as an adequate substitute for reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance.
